ova90s.name: 90年代OVA
ova90s.en: 90s OVA animation style. Cel animation look. High saturation colors. Hard shadows (not block shadows). Film grain texture. Natural human proportions. Soft gradient blush. Thick but not jagged outlines. 4K.
ova90s.forbid: 写实质感、实拍质感、3D比例、粗黑锯齿轮廓、块状阴影

helltaker-look.name: 地狱把妹王（外观版）
helltaker-look.en: Helltaker game visual aesthetic. High contrast black/white/deep red color palette. Flat cartoon character design — slightly larger head, slender limbs, flat torso, simplified geometric shapes. Thick jagged black outlines. Flat cel-shaded coloring with block shadows, no gradients. Render characters as 2D cartoons, NOT realistic. NO photorealistic textures, NO realistic skin shading, NO 3D proportions, NO PBR materials.
helltaker-look.forbid: 写实质感、写实皮肤阴影、3D比例、PBR材质、渐变、柔光、模糊、照片级渲染

toon3d-pbr.name: 三渲二+PBR混合
toon3d-pbr.en: 3D cel-shaded animation with PBR rendering. Thin dark outlines (not thick hand-drawn lines). Subsurface scattering on skin — soft, translucent, delicate. Soft studio lighting. Smooth shadow transitions, soft diffused shadows. Realistic fabric textures with wrinkles and bump. 3D physical hair strands with clear groups. Clean render, smooth surfaces.
toon3d-pbr.forbid: 粗黑手绘轮廓线、纯平涂赛璐珞、硬块状阴影、写实人类皮肤质感
